comment: sc-10 seeded bugs (Lean, the only language this item changes). M1 and M5 were run twice: as planted (supX_pull's proof fails), and again with supX_pull's proof stubbed for that run only, so that the examples file elaborates and the #guards it breaks are listed. Line numbers are of the files at the commit that adds this file.
